integrity: The current published primary full text was inspected at the definitions, polytope equality, Proposition 4.4, Open Question 4.5, and examples. The new direction is independently proved by selecting an opposite-support pair attaining s_K(u) and perturbing the direction along its tangential component. The only imported scientific premise is the published upper bound in Proposition 4.4; the package states this explicitly. A standalone numerical checker exercises nonsmooth and smooth examples but is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem settles the refined width equalities only. It does not settle the separate diameter-function questions in the source. The originality search found no equivalent all-convex-body statement, but a differently phrased or unindexed convex-analysis observation remains a residual risk.
title: Exact refined width-Lipschitz modulus for every convex body
